instrumentation_overhead: Stopwatch timing plus runtime allocation/process memory counters; paired paths are used where overhead is compared.
interpretation: Snapshot includes pending process and command/RNG state; identical post-load antecedents must replay to identical serialized state.
safety_margin_rationale: This runner class is a reproducible CI reference baseline only; no product-scale capacity is inferred.
regression_threshold: Investigate a same-workload mean regression above 25%; do not auto-fail before an accepted baseline history exists.
